mentions.name: LLM screenplay generation strategies
mentions.description: This project develops effective strategies for getting LLMs to generate screenplays that are not terrible; the author reports having found some approaches that seem to work.
mentions.problem: LLMs tend to generate terrible screenplays, so the author is working on strategies to improve their output quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: Not really a "thing" but I'm trying to come up with effective strategies for LLMs to generate screenplays that are not terrible. I think I have some that seem to work.
mentions.author: iknownthing
